searchText: I believe constant. Warming it up requires a witness? I think constant cost, mostly because it's simpler and I have a hard time seeing how a variable cost system would improve the situation. Just because something is **REALLY** cold, doesn't necessarily make is less valuable or less likely to be needed and it's hard for me to see what extra value is added by making the cost variable. (also, this is probably a conversation for <#796057759858425866> or maybe <#739145593762611250> as this channel is more focused on the historical blocks/headers/receipts type of data.)
